_doc: Every node type of a behaviour tree (Rust ecs::behavior_tree::BtNode) as the editor offers it: its group, what it does, the node it starts as, and the fields its form edits. The Rust test behavior_tree_nodes_match_the_editor deserializes every default and fails a BtNode variant missing here.

nodes.doc: Each child in turn while they succeed; fails with the first that fails.

fields.name: reactive
fields.doc: Look again from the first child every frame (put conditions first)

nodes.doc: Each child in turn while they fail; succeeds with the first that does.

fields.name: reactive
fields.doc: Look again from the first child every frame: a higher-priority branch that starts aborts the one running

nodes.doc: Every child at once: succeeds when `succeed` of them have (0: all).

fields.name: succeed
fields.doc: How many children must succeed (0: all)

nodes.doc: One child, picked at random each time it starts.
Success for failure and failure for success.
Success whatever the child answers (once it has finished).
The child again, once a frame at most: `times` times (0: forever), or until it fails.

fields.name: until_failure
fields.doc: Repeat until the child fails, then succeed

nodes.doc: Fails without running the child for `seconds` after it last finished.

fields.name: seconds
fields.doc: Seconds before the child may run again

nodes.doc: Aborts the child and fails if it runs longer than `seconds`.
A blackboard key against a value.

fields.name: op
fields.doc: The comparison; `set` is present and not false, 0 or empty

fields.name: value
fields.doc: What to compare with (a number, a string, true / false)

nodes.doc: Succeeds when the target is within `distance`.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: An entity's name, the nearest with a tag (`tag:guard`), or a blackboard key (`@goal`)

fields.name: store
fields.doc: Keep the target's position under this blackboard key (empty: don't)

nodes.doc: Runs for `seconds` (plus up to `jitter` more, at random).

fields.name: jitter
fields.doc: Up to this many seconds more, at random

nodes.doc: Goes to within `arrive` of the target (or away from it) at `speed`, through the entity's nav_agent when it has one.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: As `near`'s target, or a point [x, y]

fields.name: away
fields.doc: Flee: go until this far from it

nodes.doc: Writes a blackboard key (adds to it, with `add`).

fields.name: add
fields.doc: Add to the number there instead

nodes.doc: Writes any component field on the entity or the named target.
Calls `on_<event>` on the entity's script and succeeds.
Calls `on_<call>` and runs until the script writes "success" or "failure" to the blackboard key <call>.

fields.name: call
fields.doc: Calls on_<call>, answered under the key <call>
